segments.name: Grocery & Snacks
segments.description: Branded, shelf-stable food products sold in various retail channels in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Grocery & Snacks reporting segment principally includes branded, shelf-stable food products sold in various retail channels in the United States.

segments.name: Refrigerated & Frozen
segments.description: Branded, temperature-controlled food products sold in various retail channels in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Refrigerated & Frozen reporting segment principally includes branded, temperature-controlled food products sold in various retail channels in the United States.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Branded food products in various temperature states sold in retail and foodservice channels outside the United States.
segments.evidence: The International reporting segment principally includes branded food products, in various temperature states, sold in various retail and foodservice channels outside of the United States.

segments.name: Foodservice
segments.description: Branded and customized food products packaged for sale to restaurants and foodservice establishments primarily in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Foodservice reporting segment includes branded and customized food products, including meals, entrees, sauces, and a variety of custom-manufactured culinary products packaged for sale to restaurants and other foodservice establishments primarily in the United States.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for branded food products and customized food items sold through retail and foodservice channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are sold, directly and through distributors, to chain, wholesale, value, cooperative, club, and independent grocery, pharmacy and drug, convenience and other store operators; and foodservice customers, including restaurants and bars, travel and leisure customers, schools, health care facilities, and government customers.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the Chef Boyardee business was sold in the first quarter, reducing segment net sales.
changes.evidence: Fiscal 2026 and 2025 included $7.0 million and $385.9 million, respectively, of net sales related to our Chef Boyardee ® business, which was sold in the first quarter of fiscal 2026.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the frozen fish business was sold in the first quarter, reducing segment net sales.
changes.evidence: Fiscal 2026 and 2025 included $4.9 million and $76.8 million, respectively, of net sales related to our frozen fish business, which was sold in the first quarter of fiscal 2026.
